snippet_primary: "Most makers frame this as marketplace convenience versus storefront control. The decision comes down to business trajectory: are you testing whether people will buy your hand-poured candles, or are you building a candle brand that customers seek out by name? That distinction shapes everything from your fee structure (10.4% on Etsy vs. 3.89% on Shopify at higher volumes) to your customer relationships (marketplace traffic vs. owned email lists) to your ceiling for growth (70-variant limits on Etsy vs. 2,048 on Shopify)."
